landing.title: Learn everyday sentences you can use right away, with Vietnamese meanings
landing.lead: {languages} languages. Each session is 8 sentences in about 5 minutes: read the meaning, listen to a voice, rate yourself, then choose the right meaning. The app reminds you to review at the right time so you keep what you learned.
landing.shotAlt: The VITASR Learn screen: a sentence card, the Listen button, the Learn 8 sentences button and the next units

learner.title: Vietnamese speakers learning a language
learner.body: Every sentence has a Vietnamese meaning, usage notes and a situation; no prior knowledge needed.

busy.title: Busy people learning bit by bit
busy.body: Just 8 sentences per session. Stop halfway and your results are kept; next time you continue where you left off.

traveler.title: People who need sentences for a task
traveler.body: Search by keyword such as <vi>đặt phòng, sân bay, ăn uống</vi> and learn that group of sentences right away.

landing.statGlobal: Global English (English, A1 to C2), {units} units

session.title: 8-sentence sessions
session.body: See the meaning, recall the original, rate "I remember" or "Review again", then choose the right meaning.

listen.title: Listen to a voice
listen.body: Listen once or on repeat with your device's voice, at the speed you choose.

review.title: Review at the right time
review.body: Sentences you remember come back after 1, 3, 7, 14 and then 30 days; ones you missed come back right away.

test.title: Quick tests
test.body: Three steps per unit: listen and choose, listen by chunks, put in order. Pause and continue any time.

library.title: A library by unit
library.body: See units and the progress of each, search sentences, filter by topic, level and status.

progress.title: Track your progress
progress.body: Sentences learned per day, a weekly session goal and the review schedule for the days ahead.

choose.title: Create an account and choose a language
choose.body: Pick one of the languages; English has two sentence sets to choose from.

learn.title: Learn your first 8 sentences
learn.body: The app guides you the first time; each group takes about 5 minutes.

review.title: Come back to review and test
review.body: Practice shows how many sentences you have to review today.

landing.finalBody: Create an account, choose a language and learn your first group.
landing.demoFinalBody: Choose a language and learn your first group, no account needed.
